card.name: Start of myelosuppression and mycophenolate
card.fires_on: The first piece of long drug or condition terms starting with 'my' or 'ant', such as myelosuppression and mycophenolic acid or mofetil, plus an occasional 'of' in 'relief of'.

modes.label: my- terms
modes.description: Opening 'my' or 'c' piece of myelosuppression or mycophenolate/mycophenolic.
modes.example: Higher than recommended repeat doses are associated with increased<< my>>elosuppression including leukopenia

modes.label: ant- before antipsychotics
modes.description: The 'ant' piece starting antipsychotics after 'other than'.
modes.example: who have failed to respond to psychotherapy or medications other than<< ant>>ipsychotics, it should be noted

modes.label: Relief of
modes.description: The word 'of' after 'For the relief' in indication text.
modes.example: 2.3 Rheumatoid Arthritis For the relief<< of>> the signs and symptoms of rheumatoid

card.writes: It slightly favors odd name fragments and pushes down cognitive/functional words, with no clear meaning.
card.plain: It lights up at the start of words like myelosuppression and mycophenolate in drug labels.
